question: Which goddess forms are invoked to protect the throat and the two breasts?
premises: Mahāvāṇī is asked to protect the throat
Jaganmātā is asked to protect the two breasts
inference: Mahāvāṇī protects the throat and the world-mother protects the two breasts.
plain_english: May Mahāvāṇī protect the throat, and may the world-mother protect the two breasts.
